properties.title: Stone house in Pépieux
properties.short_description: Built in 1850 and originally part of a château, this village house keeps its original features — a water pump, exposed beams, decorative roof tiles. Tastefully refitted, with a quintessential French country feel.

properties.title: Village house in Le Vigeant
properties.short_description: A pretty two-bedroom home with a courtyard, a walled garden, a pool and a barn, within walking distance of the village restaurants and riverside walks of Le Vigeant.

properties.title: Stone cottage near Merdrignac
properties.short_description: A beautifully presented and tastefully decorated stone house near Merdrignac in the Côtes-d'Armor, with a terrace, parking and a 265 m² plot.

properties.title: Timber-framed house in Lacaze
properties.short_description: An authentic timber-framed house in the medieval village of Lacaze, a listed Petite Cité de Caractère in the Tarn. Once home to the arquebusier of the Château des Comtes de Bourbon Malause — the château is visible from the house.

properties.title: Stone cottage project in Champgenéteux
properties.short_description: Three stone buildings — a habitable cottage, a second house to renovate and a ruin — on 2,225 m² with countryside views and gîte potential, in the Mayenne countryside.

properties.title: Stone cottage in Pressignac
properties.short_description: A characterful stone cottage in a pretty hamlet near Pressignac: two bedrooms, a lounge/dining room with fitted kitchen, a small garden and a barn.

properties.title: Stone house in La Chapelle-Montbrandeix
properties.short_description: A three-bedroom stone house on the edge of the village, with a beautiful garden of 1,646 m² and a large outbuilding, in the Parc naturel régional Périgord-Limousin.

properties.title: Farmhouse in Thollet
properties.short_description: A hamlet farmhouse near Thollet with three bedrooms plus a study, a patio with a hot tub, and open Vienne countryside all around.

properties.title: Cottage in Saint-Sébastien
properties.short_description: A charming three-bedroom cottage in good condition in the Creuse, with a 400 m² garden. Currently under offer.

properties.title: Country house in Locarn
properties.short_description: A detached, luminous two-bedroom house with a balcony enjoying stunning countryside views, plus a garage and terrace, near Locarn in central Brittany. Currently under offer.

properties.title: House in Saint-Ouen-la-Thène
properties.short_description: A detached house with three bedrooms and three bathrooms, gardens and a dependance, in a calm and quiet spot 12 km from Matha in the Charente-Maritime.

properties.title: Stone house in Saint-Germain-de-Confolens
properties.short_description: A charming detached character home in a highly popular riverside village at the confluence of the Vienne and Issoire, near Confolens and all amenities.

properties.title: Village house in Exideuil-sur-Vienne
properties.short_description: A big village house of 189 m² with five bedrooms, garden and outbuildings — with the potential to split into two homes. Fibre and mains drainage.

properties.title: Stone house in Azillanet
properties.short_description: A quality 2017 renovation of an 1874 stone house in the Minervois: two bedrooms and a sun terrace with fabulous views. Currently under offer.

properties.title: Stone house near Gourdon
properties.short_description: A 15th & 19th-century stone house in a small hamlet 4 km from Gourdon, dominated by its 12th–16th century church. Exposed beams and stone, fireplaces, a mullioned window with window seat. Three bedrooms, a convertible attic, a shaded garden and a wooden terrace with open views of the countryside. The 19th-century bread oven remains in its original state.

properties.title: Colombage house in Gacé
properties.short_description: A traditional timber-framed colombage house in the heart of the Pays d'Auge — 150 m², three to four bedrooms, a 50 m² terrace and a 690 m² plot.

properties.title: Village house in La Roque-sur-Cèze
properties.short_description: A house full of authenticity in one of France's most beautiful medieval villages, above the Cèze valley — two bedrooms and two terraces with panoramic views.

properties.title: Stone house near Ribérac
properties.short_description: A stone house in a quiet hamlet near Ribérac with two period fireplaces, exposed beams and wooden floors — and more than eight hectares of land.

properties.title: House in Saint-Sulpice-les-Feuilles
properties.short_description: A house of character with a marble fireplace and an oak staircase, a courtyard dining space and a garden with its own well.

properties.title: Stone cottage near Chalais
properties.short_description: A stone cottage in a hamlet near Chalais, with a fireplace and original features, a garden and parking.

properties.title: House in La Trimouille
properties.short_description: A renovated single-storey village house with a fireplace, parquet floors and old windows, a 1,462 m² garden and outbuildings.

properties.title: Stone house near Châteauponsac
properties.short_description: A fully restored stone house in the Limousin countryside near Châteauponsac, with a wood stove, a large attached barn and a 2,917 m² garden.

properties.title: Stone house in Chamberet
properties.short_description: A pretty stone house on the edge of the lively village of Chamberet: an old staircase, an open fireplace and a summer kitchen, with a 1,835 m² garden and a big garage.

properties.title: Farmhouse in Valzergues
properties.short_description: An authentic 1900 stone country house in the heart of an Aveyron village, on a flat green plot of 1,679 m² — with a covered balcony, cellars and a two-level 98 m² stone barn. Ideal for heritage lovers.

properties.title: House in a Pyrenean hamlet, Lacourt
properties.short_description: A fully renovated house in a Pyrenean hamlet at 600 m altitude — no work required. A 20 m² terrace, a 28 m² convertible attic and a 387 m² plot in the Couserans.

properties.title: Watermill on the Seye, Ginals
properties.short_description: An 1800s watermill on the banks of the river Seye, with about 1.1 hectares of woodland and garden and its own water rights. The interior requires general updating.

properties.title: House in a hamlet in Millac
properties.short_description: A house in a hamlet, with beams, stone floors and a fireplace. The nearest shop, bar and café are 5 km away.

properties.title: Modernised house in Ladapeyre
properties.short_description: A fully modernised house in a historic village with a château. The village has a bakery, a bar and a post office.

properties.title: Renovated village house in Siran
properties.short_description: A renovated village house in the Minervois, with exposed stone walls and a small private terrace.

properties.title: Village house in Jumilhac-le-Grand
properties.short_description: A renovated village house in sight of the château. Both bedrooms keep their original chimneys.

properties.title: Stone house in Avène
properties.short_description: A stone house in a hamlet, with a conservatory, a wood burner and three double bedrooms.

properties.title: Stone farmhouse in Saint-Laurent-de-Céris
properties.short_description: A detached stone farmhouse with a large attached barn. The village bar, bakery and shop are a short walk away.
